phase_name: The Host Can See Where They Stand — Verification Roadmap & the Deliberate Resubmit

Verification roadmap.question: Where should the complete four-step verification roadmap live?
How should the roadmap be composed?
Verification roadmap.answer: Separate cards; selected after a three-variant experiential spike and an eight-state stress spike

Verification roadmap.question: When a host has one live listing and another rejected listing, is the account-level journey complete?
Verification roadmap.answer: Yes. The journey completes when the first listing is live; rejected sibling listings remain actionable on their own listing cards.
options_presented: Remain incomplete while any listing is rejected
Treat each listing as a separate roadmap

Verification roadmap.question: What should the dashboard show after all four roadmap steps are complete?
Verification roadmap.answer: Collapse the roadmap into one compact ‘Ready to take bookings’ summary
options_presented: Keep all four completed cards visible
